title: Retrograde Labeling of BAT-Projecting Sympathetic Neurons with CTB
author: Seoeun Lee
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wjrfcm6

steps.title: Prepare CTB Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1% CTB stock solution and aliquot for storage.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 500 ug CTB powder in 50 ul saline to create a 1% stock solution.
Aliquot 4 ul of the 1% CTB solution into individual bottles.
Store aliquots at -20ºC.

steps.title: Prepare CTB for Injection
steps.instruction: Thaw and adjust the CTB solution to the desired final volume.

substeps.instruction: Remove frozen CTB solution from storage.
Adjust with saline to the final desired volume (e.g., add 16 ul of saline to a 4 ul aliquot to reach a total volume of 20 ul, allowing for 10 ul per depot).

steps.title: Anesthetize and Prepare Animal
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the animal and prepare the surgical site.

substeps.instruction: Anesthetize the animal with isoflurane and maintain anesthesia throughout the procedure.
Verify unconsciousness via toe pinch.
Place animal on a heating pad and lubricate eyes with ophthalmic ointment.
Inject buprenorphine (100 µl/ 10 µg) at the surgical site for analgesia.
Remove hair from the interscapular region.
Scrub the surgical area 3 times each with povidone-iodine and 70% isopropyl alcohol.

steps.title: Set Up Sterile Field
steps.instruction: Prepare sterile tools and the operating area.

substeps.instruction: Open the sterilized pouch with tools.
Place the suture on the sterile space (retain the plastic cover for CTB drops).
Uncover and place the sterile draping on the sterile space.
Cut a hole in the sterile draping corresponding to the size of the operating site.
Load CTB into a syringe (10 ul for each depot) while wearing sterile gloves.
Alternatively, 1-2 ul of lower volume can be injected using a Hamilton syringe or a mouth pipette with a pulled glass needle.

steps.title: Perform BAT Injection
steps.instruction: Inject CTB bilaterally into the brown adipose tissue (BAT).

substeps.instruction: Make a shallow incision at the center of the shaved area (1 cm below the head), extending approximately 0.5 cm bilaterally.
Grasp the adipose tissue on one side, locate the BAT, and inject the CTB solution.
Repeat the injection on the opposite side to complete the bilateral procedure.

steps.title: Close Surgical Site
steps.instruction: Close the wound and provide post-operative care.

substeps.instruction: Gently replace the fat pad and close the wound using a 4-0 PS-4 suture.
Wipe the closed wound with Povidone-iodine and alcohol prep.
Inject buprenorphine or appropriate analgesics every 4-12 hours for 48 hours post-surgery.

steps.title: Harvest and Fix Stellate Ganglia
steps.instruction: Sacrifice the animal and preserve the target tissue.

substeps.instruction: Sacrifice the animals 3 days after the injection.
Dissect out the stellate ganglia (SG) on a slide with cold PBS.
Fix the dissected SG in 4% PFA in 0.1M PB for 1 hour.
Wash with PBS overnight at 4ºC.

steps.title: Mount and Image SG
steps.instruction: Mount the tissue for confocal microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Attach an iSpacer to a glass slide.
Locate the SG inside the spacer (stretch SG horizontally for optimal imaging).
Mount with approximately 110 ul of Vectashield and a cover slip.
Image the SG using a Zeiss confocal 710 with tile scan and z-stack options.
